topics.title: Howard Receives Congratulatory Messages
topics.summary: The host describes receiving numerous congratulatory messages from listeners, primarily older adults who were critical of a rival radio personality. He recounts encounters where individuals expressed their satisfaction with his actions and highlighted the widespread negative sentiment surrounding the defeated individual in Philadelphia.

topics.title: Stern Discusses Rate Reduction, Columnist
topics.summary: Two individuals discuss a desire for lower advertising rates with Stern, while one expresses concern about a mentally unstable columnist. The conversation references past events like the fall of the Berlin Wall and a recent defeat attributed to 'the stern gang'.

topics.title: Radio Contest - Philadelphia Dinner Suggestions
topics.summary: Tom hosts a radio contest inviting listeners to suggest dinner locations in Philadelphia via letter or phone call; participants are encouraged to provide recommendations for the host's daily game play.

topics.title: Radio Host Promotes Contest, Shares Personal Stories
topics.summary: The radio host announces a contest offering prizes up to $25,000 for home videos and then discusses an incident involving John DeBella at his bar. The conversation shifts to the listener’s dating life with suggestions about contacting potential partners.

topics.title: Andy Bloom Discusses Stu Bikovsky Contest Idea
topics.summary: Program director Andy Bloom discusses a column by Stu Bikovsky proposing a contest for zoo ideas, noting the potential difficulty of receiving submissions and making a lighthearted comment about Philadelphia.

topics.title: Man Challenges Columnist’s Birthday Suggestion
topics.summary: A man disputes the columnist’s offer of a Philadelphia tour and expresses skepticism about meeting him, referencing previous comments and a contest for ideas on where to take ‘stu.’
